name: Amatsu Yuris
source:
Liked things: Sake, cocktails, beer, all kinds of liquor
Hobby: Home gardening

She's Yukito and Sasha's mother.  Although powerful, she has retired from active duty as a witch. She is called the "strongest" witch alive. Despite of her young look, she is 40 years old.
